title: Monitoring drift: does a concept-vector probe's threshold silently rot across prompt domains?

original_idea.body: Calibrate a probe threshold on one domain, apply unchanged across domains, measure FP/FN drift and recalibration fix. Inference-only.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: silent threshold rot is a realistic dangerous failure for internal safety monitors; concrete deployment scenario (level 4).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Threshold calibration + cross-domain FP/FN stats; standard tools, motivated beginner feasible (level 5).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (drift quantification + recalibration fix), few dependencies (level 4).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly monitoring-infrastructure work on open models (level 4).

low_compute.reasoning: Inference-only calibration on cached activations, near free-tier (level 5).

novelty.reasoning: OOD detector degradation studied; the fixed-threshold rot + recalibration angle may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: OOD degradation known; the threshold-rot-and-recalibration framing may be open.
